_doc: Replaces knowledge3d/tablet/wine/game2d_wine.py hot-path logic. Python shrinks to bytes pipe at boot. ingress reads an ARC3 frame header and grid cells, maps cells to Reality Galaxy atom IDs, produces a 2D grid Galaxy form. egress takes a chosen ACTION2 from the Galaxy and serializes to ARC3 action envelope format. visual renders the grid as Drawing Galaxy primitives on the Tablet.
## TODO: contract_hash is symbolic — loader must compute murmur3(paradigm_signature) at Galaxy load time. arc3_frame_ingress RPN program must encode the cell-to-atom mapping table as a Grammar Galaxy rule, not as a Python dict. ARC3 game IDs carry hash suffixes (e.g. ls20-9607627b) — the ingress program must strip the suffix before atom lookup.

_doc: Base terminal I/O contract for benchmarks and live chat mode. ingress tokenizes input bytes by whitespace and maps tokens to Word/Character Galaxy refs. egress renders a Word-Galaxy sequence to UTF-8 bytes and writes to Tablet output ring. No visual symlink — pure text pipeline.
## TODO: contract_hash is symbolic — loader must compute murmur3(paradigm_signature) at Galaxy load time. text_tokenize_whitespace must be promoted from Stage 0 recipe to registered rpn_template in canonical registry before Galaxy load. visual_rpn_symlink is intentionally 0 (null) for this contract — loader must not reject null visual fields.
